roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON). This leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment, supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care.

We are looking for a proactive leader who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and fostering a supportive team atmosphere. salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, commensurate with experience.

description:

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00 and the opportunity to make a significant impact on resident care and facility compliance.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing individualized care plans, and ensuring accurate documentation in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise in MDS 3.0 will be crucial in optimizing reimbursement and maintaining high standards of quality care.

We are looking for a professional with strong clinical assessment skills and a commitment to excellence. While a Registered Nurse (RN) license is preferred, we encourage qualified candidates to apply and become a key part of our compassionate care team.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa (preferred) or other relevant clinical licensure.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and comprehensive knowledge of federal and state regulations.
Strong assessment, documentation, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience and qualifications.
